description:
Listing: 392 Smith Lane Bruceville-Eddy, TX 76630
Agent: Joanna Pearce - (254) 220-0340 - joannasellstx@gmail.com 
Full Tour: http://helpfulrealtor.us/listings/392-smith-lane-brucevilleeddy-tx-76630-1

Amazing 2420 sq. ft. home on 2.17 wooded acres, 15 min from Waco or Temple and 20 min from Baylor University. Gated entry, circle drive. Tall ceilings in this geodesic dome home with 3 BR / 2 ½ bath; porcelain tile, huge showers, separate tub in master with dual sinks on custom cabinetry, plus a lovely powder room. New Pergo floors in the master and upstairs bedrooms. New windows and sliding doors in the whole house. Attached vented atrium to enjoy in any weather. Includes detached 2400 sq. ft. shop on cement slab: rm 1 - 322sq’ sunroom (convert to mini apt?); rm 2 - 530sq’ stained/sealed floor, 11’ ceiling; rm 3 - 2 massive workbenches, outlets galore, pegboards, cabinets, shelf units; rm 4 - 3 walls of heavy wood shelving. Generous 16’x16’ woodshed & 10’ x 20’ Tuff Shed (built 2016) for lawn tools. Keyhole garden, 6’ fire pit, 2 outdoor tables. House roof is 3 years old, and the shop roof is 5 years old. Grab this opportunity to own your piece of the country with close city access!
